card.name: Initials and decimals in citations
card.fires_on: Author first-name initials or name parts in reference lists and bylines, right after a surname or comma. Also the decimal point or unit right after a number in dose text.

modes.label: Author initials
modes.description: An initial or first-name part of an author in a citation list, after a surname.
modes.example: January 30, 2008 Citation: Maddox, V., Bryson, C.T., Byrd, Jr.,<< J>>.D. 2008.

modes.label: Decimal or unit in doses
modes.description: The decimal point or the mg unit right after a number in dose statements.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where an author's initial or first name comes up, and sometimes the decimal or unit in a dose.
